evaluations.evidence: search and discover music using content identification or fingerprinting
evaluations.rationale: Search and discover is a single conceptual feature, and content identification/fingerprinting are synonymous mechanisms.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on my profile
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for profile-based music discovery.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music based on other users similar to myself
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for collaborative filtering-based music discovery.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music or ringback tones
evaluations.rationale: Music and ringback tones are merely attributes/types of content for a single discovery feature.

evaluations.evidence: search and discover music by exploiting enriched metadata and image tags
evaluations.rationale: Metadata and image tags are attributes used by a single search feature.

evaluations.evidence: upload tagged videos and have tags available for all further processing steps
evaluations.rationale: Uploading tagged videos and making those tags available is a single cohesive workflow.

evaluations.evidence: view thumbnail sequences of video segments
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for viewing thumbnail sequences.

evaluations.evidence: get info about similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for retrieving information about similar videos.

evaluations.evidence: get info about perceptually similar video items and segments
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for retrieving information about perceptually similar videos.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations from similar profiles
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for receiving recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: receive content recommendations based on most relevant news events in my area
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for location/news-based recommendations.

evaluations.evidence: identify persons in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines two independently implementable features: identifying persons (computer vision) and retrieving related information (database lookup).

evaluations.evidence: identify products in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines two independently implementable features: identifying products and retrieving related information.

evaluations.evidence: identify broadcaster logos in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines two independently implementable features: identifying logos and retrieving related information.

evaluations.evidence: identify brands in videos, and receive related information about them
evaluations.rationale: Combines two independently implementable features: identifying brands and retrieving related information.

evaluations.evidence: take a picture or upload an image
evaluations.rationale: Taking a picture (camera integration) and uploading an image (file system access) are two independently implementable input features.

evaluations.evidence: access content using a geographical map and be informed if there are videos covering the area
evaluations.rationale: Combines a map-based content access interface with a location-based notification/alert system.

evaluations.evidence: search content items using automatic speech recognition
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for voice search.

evaluations.evidence: see, validate and edit segmentation of videos
evaluations.rationale: Viewing, validating, and editing are distinct operations that can be prioritized and implemented independently.

evaluations.evidence: annotate news video segments and extract a topic for each segment
evaluations.rationale: Annotating segments and extracting topics are two distinct features (manual annotation vs. automatic extraction).

evaluations.evidence: filter and rank videos based on A/V quality aspects
evaluations.rationale: Filtering (excluding items) and ranking (ordering items) are two distinct operations.

evaluations.evidence: get a quick assessment of whether audio material has been edited before the upload
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for audio edit detection.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter nudity content
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for content filtering.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter content using search based on low­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for prefiltering content.

evaluations.evidence: automatically validated the ingested contents for copyright infringement
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for copyright validation.

evaluations.evidence: prefilter the content using search on high­level asset information
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for prefiltering content.

evaluations.evidence: based on automated analysis, citizen annotations, and comments on Talk
evaluations.rationale: Combines three distinct data sources (automated analysis, annotations, comments) that require independent integration efforts.

evaluations.evidence: based on annotations and information from Talk comments
evaluations.rationale: Combines two distinct data sources (annotations and Talk comments) that require independent integration efforts.

evaluations.evidence: identify volunteer types
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for identifying volunteer types.

evaluations.evidence: preclassify the Galaxy Zoo images using simple low­level image features
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for image preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Snapshot Serengeti images with no classifiable animals in them
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for empty image detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic image series detection for the case of timestamping malfunction
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for image series detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal species preclassification
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal attribute preclassification
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for attribute preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic animal number detection
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for animal counting.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic segmentation or localization of plankton
evaluations.rationale: Segmentation and localization are synonymous/tightly coupled computer vision tasks representing a single feature.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect Plankton Portal images with no classifiable plankton in them
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for empty image detection.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic detection of plankton size or orientation
evaluations.rationale: Size detection and orientation detection are two distinct measurements/algorithms that can be implemented independently.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic preclassification of plankton species
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for species preclassification.

evaluations.evidence: perform automatic worm motion analysis to reduce video duration
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for motion analysis.

evaluations.evidence: automatically detect the time in a Worm Watch Lab video where the worm lays an egg
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for event detection.

evaluations.evidence: detect important features such as areas of flooding, damage, temporary shelters, blocked roads etc
evaluations.rationale: Detecting multiple distinct classes of objects/events (flooding, damage, shelters, roads) requires different models and can be prioritized independently.

evaluations.evidence: assess the probability/weight of a volunteer’s classification based on their experience
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for weighting classifications.

evaluations.evidence: remove artefacts such as bright stars and camera read errors
evaluations.rationale: Removing bright stars and removing camera read errors are two distinct artefact removal algorithms.

evaluations.evidence: detect moving and transient objects in the images
evaluations.rationale: Moving and transient objects are typically detected by a single difference imaging pipeline.

evaluations.evidence: remove background noise and distracting sounds from the audio files
evaluations.rationale: Background noise and distracting sounds are handled by a single audio processing feature.

evaluations.evidence: group whale calls that are similar
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for grouping/clustering.

evaluations.evidence: identify the number of whales heard in a single audio file
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for counting.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should interrupt a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for timing interruptions.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should interrupt a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for determining the medium of interruption.

evaluations.evidence: know when I should educate a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for timing education.

evaluations.evidence: know whether I should educate a volunteer with text, an image, or a video
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for determining the medium of education.

evaluations.evidence: know which piece of education I should give to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for selecting educational content.

evaluations.evidence: know when a volunteer has made an interesting comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for detecting interesting comments.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should comment on a subject
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for bot comment timing.

evaluations.evidence: know when Zoonibot should give an explanation
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for bot explanation timing.

evaluations.evidence: know what Zoonibot should say to a volunteer
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for determining bot dialogue.

evaluations.evidence: group subjects by similarity
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for grouping subjects.

evaluations.evidence: recommend different projects to volunteers based on their previous experiences
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for project recommendation.

evaluations.evidence: see a summary of articles, so that I reuse them
evaluations.rationale: Expresses a single feature for viewing article summaries.
